suspects.name: Reginald Sterling
suspects.physicalDescription: Tall and lean with sharp features, slicked-back dark hair, and a perpetually impatient expression. He favors expensive but slightly worn suits.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in the victim's study arguing with the victim and then committed the murder.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Claims he was out for a late-night walk in the gardens during the estimated time of death.
suspects.trueMotive: Desperate need for money due to gambling debts and frustration over inheritance.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He has significant gambling debts he's trying to conceal.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes visibly agitated when asked about his finances or his relationship with the victim's finances.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Eliza was having discreet meetings with his uncle and suspects it was about something sensitive. He also knows Beatrice is overly ambitious.

suspects.name: Beatrice Albright
suspects.personality: Ambitious, sharp-tongued, and always looking for an angle
suspects.physicalDescription: Impeccably dressed with sharp, calculating eyes and a firm handshake. Her grey hair is neatly styled, and she carries herself with an air of authority.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in her private office at home, working on business proposals for Mr. Abernathy.
suspects.claimedAlibi: States she was in her private office at home, working late.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: She was secretly negotiating a buyout of Abernathy's company, which he was resistant to.
suspects.lyingTells: Avoids direct questions about the future of the business and Abernathy's company.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Reginald has financial troubles and suspects he was pressuring his uncle. She is also aware Eliza was a frequent visitor.

suspects.name: Eliza Hawthorne
suspects.physicalDescription: Graceful and elegant, with long dark hair, a small, refined nose, and gentle pink lips. She has a small, barely noticeable mole near her left eye.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was secretly meeting with the victim in his study to discuss a sensitive personal matter.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Claims she was in the main library, reading.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: She was meeting Mr. Abernathy to discuss a highly personal and potentially scandalous matter involving his past.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes defensive when asked about the nature of her relationship with Mr. Abernathy or the specific contents of the note.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Beatrice was pushing Abernathy to sell his company. She also knows Reginald was struggling financially.

suspects.name: Charles Abernathy
suspects.personality: Gruff, protective, and loyal to the victim
suspects.physicalDescription: A sturdy man with a weathered face, a prominent mustache, and thick, expressive eyebrows. He often wears practical, slightly rumpled clothing, including a noticeable green shirt.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in the kitchen preparing late-night tea for the household.
suspects.claimedAlibi: States he was in the kitchen, preparing tea.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Reginald was always asking his uncle for money and was never satisfied. He also knows Beatrice and his uncle had frequent, sometimes heated, business discussions.
